title: Hourglass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sandTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD166"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F4A261"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sandBot" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F4A261"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E76F51"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Top plate -->
  <rect x="18" y="10" width="64" height="8" rx="3" fill="#8ECAE6"/>
  <rect x="22" y="12" width="56" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ADE8F4"/>

  <!-- Bottom plate -->
  <rect x="18" y="82" width="64" height="8" rx="3" fill="#8ECAE6"/>
  <rect x="22" y="84" width="56" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ADE8F4"/>

  <!-- Glass body left -->
  <path d="M28 18 L28 42 Q28 50 38 50 L38 50 Q48 50 48 58 L48 82 L28 82 Z" fill="#D4F1F9" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Glass body right -->
  <path d="M72 18 L72 42 Q72 50 62 50 Q52 50 52 58 L52 82 L72 82 Z" fill="#D4F1F9" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Glass outline left -->
  <path d="M28 18 L28 42 Q28 50 38 50 Q48 50 48 58 L48 82" fill="none" stroke="#ADE8F4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Glass outline right -->
  <path d="M72 18 L72 42 Q72 50 62 50 Q52 50 52 58 L52 82" fill="none" stroke="#ADE8F4" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Top sand -->
  <path d="M30 20 L30 42 Q30 48 40 48 Q50 48 50 56 L50 58 L30 58 Z" fill="url(#sandTop)"/>
  <path d="M70 20 L70 42 Q70 48 60 48 Q50 48 50 56 L50 58 L70 58 Z" fill="url(#sandTop)"/>

  <!-- Bottom sand -->
  <path d="M30 82 L30 70 Q30 64 40 64 Q50 64 50 58 L50 60 Q50 66 40 66 Q30 66 30 72 Z" fill="url(#sandBot)"/>
  <path d="M70 82 L70 70 Q70 64 60 64 Q50 64 50 58 L50 60 Q50 66 60 66 Q70 66 70 72 Z" fill="url(#sandBot)"/>

  <!-- Sand flowing stream -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="48" width="3" height="14" fill="#FFD166" rx="1"/>

  <!-- Sand mound on bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#F4A261"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the glass -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="3" fill="#FF006E"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="3" fill="#FF006E"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="37" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 48 Q50 58 60 48" fill="none" stroke="#FF006E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="46" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFB3C6" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="46" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFB3C6" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Little sparkle details -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="80" r="1.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="80" r="1.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
</svg>
